thread:
Priya: FYI spinning up lumispark-16B-int4x canary. After some traffic, seeing p99 slowgen spikes and 2 OOMs in the first hour. Posting logs + config.
Marco: paste the runtime trace? curious if it's KV growth or transient workspace allocs.
Priya: log snip:
```
E 22:04:12 runtime: workspace alloc failed (requested=512MB)
W 22:04:12 allocator: free_chunks=10 largest_free=44MB total_free=420MB fragmented=true
I 22:04:13 kv_cache: growth to 1.3GB (triggered autotrim=false)
```
Tina: looks fragmentation + a single large tensor allocation during long outputs. What defaults did we ship for canary?
Priya: current canary defaults:
```
model: lumispark-16B-int4x
max_new_tokens: 1024
batch_size: 6
microbatching: off
kv_prefetch_mode: eager
cushion_mb: 0
slot_reserve_mb: 0
```
Raj: 1024 is risky for int4x on our shared slots. Two-pronged approach: 1) reduce max_new_tokens to 384 and enable microbatching with microbatch_size=2; 2) set cushion_mb / slot_reserve_mb to 240 to give allocator headroom.
Marco: also set `kv_prefetch_mode: adaptive` with `kv_prefetch_window: 32` so we don't pre-allocate huge KV for first tokens.
Priya: propose revised config for canary ramp:
```
{
  "model": "lumispark-16B-int4x",
  "defaults": {
    "max_new_tokens": 384,
    "batch_size": 4,
    "microbatching": true,
    "microbatch_size": 2,
    "kv_prefetch_mode": "adaptive",
    "kv_prefetch_window": 32,
    "cushion_mb": 240,
    "slot_reserve_mb": 64
  }
}
```
bench-bot: quick microbench after change (simulated load): p95 latency -25%, p99 -18%, mem headroom +310MB, OOMs 0/1h, quality delta (ROUGE-L) -0.35% vs fp16 baseline.
Tina: -0.35% ROUGE-L is borderline; what's error breakdown? long-context summarization drops more. Maybe for summarization routes we keep a pinned 16B-dedicated or allow `max_new_tokens: 1024` with dedicated slots.
Priya: good call. We'll split routes: `default` uses new conservative defaults, `long-form` mapped to dedicated-16B or 13B-compat fallback.
Marco: add a soft-fallback route: if OOM_rate > 0.5% or kv_evictions > 50/min -> route to lumispark-13B-compat. Also increase slab_compact_threshold to 6s for canary waves.
ops-bot: canary deploy initiated by Priya -> lumispark-16B-int4x @ 3% with revised defaults. Monitoring: p95/p99/oom/kv_evictions.
Priya: running 45m soak, will post final numbers. Action items: 1) update model-catalog defaults (Priya), 2) add route-based pinning for long-form (Tina), 3) add fallback policy (Marco), 4) follow-up perf run for quant-int8 comparison (Raj).
Raj: FYI doing a quick int8 quant experiment on a clone: int8 microbench shows 10% faster p95 but slightly worse tail behavior on long-context. Will share bench notes tomorrow.
Priya: wrap-up after 45m: no new OOMs, p95 improved ~22%, p99 improved 16%, KV evictions stabilized, quality delta stable at -0.33% overall. Moving canary to 15% and creating a short runbook for rollback/route-pin. Thanks all. :party:
